messages.subject: factor loadings second order CFA
parts:
Hi there,

I´m doing CFA using lavaan with two models, but the results I get in the factor loadings table are quite similar. Even more, the second-.order variables have zero values. I´m wondering if ím doing something wrong.

For the first model of 5 latent variables (ordinal data) I tried this:

modelcfaMUESTRA1='
EMOTIONAL1 =~ ssomatic + sworries + sunhappy +  sclingy + safraid
HYPER1=~ srestles +sfidgety + sdistrac + sreflect + sattends
PEER1=~ sloner + sfriend +spopular + sbullied + soldbest
CONDUCT1 =~ stantrum + sobeys + sfights +  slies + ssteals
PROSOCIAL1 =~ sconsid + sshares + scaring +  skind + shelpout
EMOTIONAL1 ~~ HYPER1
EMOTIONAL1 ~~ PEER1
EMOTIONAL1 ~~ CONDUCT1
EMOTIONAL1 ~~ PROSOCIAL1
HYPER1 ~~ PEER1
HYPER1 ~~ CONDUCT1
HYPER1 ~~ PROSOCIAL1
PEER1 ~~ CONDUCT1
PEER1 ~~ PROSOCIAL1
CONDUCT1 ~~PROSOCIAL1 '

model.ord1 = cfa(modelcfaMUESTRA1,data=CFAMUESTRA1,ordered=c(
  "ssomatic","sworries","sunhappy","sclingy", "safraid",
  "srestles" ,"sfidgety" ,"sdistrac","sreflect", "sattends",
  "sloner", "sfriend" ,"spopular" , "sbullied" , "soldbest",
  "stantrum" ,"sobeys" ,"sfights" ,"slies", "ssteals",
  "sconsid","sshares","scaring","skind", "shelpout"))

factorloadingsCFA1<-inspect(model.ord1,what="std")$lambda
View(factorloadingsCFA1)


For the second-order CFA I´m trying this:


library(lavaan)
modelcfaMUESTRA15PRINC2SEC='
EMOTIONAL521 =~ ssomatic + sworries + sunhappy +  sclingy + safraid
HYPER521=~ srestles +sfidgety + sdistrac + sreflect + sattends
PEER521=~ sloner + sfriend +spopular + sbullied + soldbest
CONDUCT521 =~ stantrum + sobeys + sfights +  slies + ssteals
PROSOCIAL521 =~ sconsid + sshares + scaring +  skind + shelpout'

FIT521 = cfa(c(modelcfaMUESTRA15PRINC2SEC,'INTERNAL521 =~ EMOTIONAL521 + PEER521
            EXTERNAL521 =~ CONDUCT521 + HYPER521
            INTERNAL521~~EXTERNAL521
            INTERNAL521~~PROSOCIAL521
            EXTERNAL521~~PROSOCIAL521'), data=CFAMUESTRA1,ordered=c(
  "ssomatic","sworries","sunhappy","sclingy", "safraid",
  "srestles" ,"sfidgety" ,"sdistrac","sreflect", "sattends",
  "sloner", "sfriend" ,"spopular" , "sbullied" , "soldbest",
  "stantrum" ,"sobeys" ,"sfights" ,"slies", "ssteals",
  "sconsid","sshares","scaring","skind", "shelpout"))

factorloadingsCFA521<-inspect(FIT521,what="std")$lambda
View(factorloadingsCFA521).

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: factor loadings second order CFA
parts: Do the degrees of freedom differ at all between the models? It looks like maybe the second model saves 1 DF. If DF are the same, then the models are equivalent. If not, then only the constraints imposed could change the loading estimates. And if the imposed constraints conform to the data, there is no reason to expect any changes in loadings.
